intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for R2dbcTelemetryHistoryRepository. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing TelemetryHistoryRepository with DatabaseClient against tables telemetry_sample (id, device_id, metric = enum name, t_device, t_ingress, value, validation_status, unique (device_id, metric, t_device)) and event_revision (id, sample_id, reason, value, t_ingress, revision_no, unique (sample_id, revision_no)). Instants are stored as UTC LocalDateTime. appendSample returns the generated id and maps a unique-identity violation to an EMPTY Mono (dedup of at-least-once retries) while every other error propagates; appendRevision computes max(revision_no)+1 (first = 1); findWindow orders by t_device ascending with LIMIT. INSERT only: no UPDATE or DELETE exists. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. REAL-SUBSTRATE RUN REQUIRED: the test boots the embedded H2 substitute through r2dbc-h2 with URL option NON_KEYWORDS=VALUE, executes the ACTUAL queued V1 and V2 Flyway migration scripts found in the project's db/migrations folder (stage-0 database step) read from the project filesystem (never retyped DDL) and asserts the durable rows read back, covering valid inserts AND constraint-violating cases. A mocked DatabaseClient case may exist only as an extra shape check beside it. Include: duplicate identity yields empty and a single row, VALIDATION_FAILED payload persisted with its raw value, revision numbers 1 then 2, window ordered by t_device not insertion order.

methods.signature: Mono<Integer> appendRevision(long sampleId, RevisionReason reason, double value, Instant tIngress)
Flux<TelemetrySample> findWindow(String deviceId, MetricKind metric, Instant from, Instant to, int limit)
